Introducing Saved Views, available today for all paid plans. Keeping your project boards organized just got easier. Instead of rebuilding the same filters and sort orders every time you open a list, you can now save your setup as a view and return to it instantly.

Each user can save up to 50 views, so whether you're tracking overdue tasks, filtering by assignee, or grouping by priority, your favorite configurations are always one click away. Views can also be shared with your team, making it simple to give everyone the same filtered perspective on a project without asking them to recreate it themselves.

Saved Views works across every list in your workspace and updates automatically as your data changes, so what you see is always current. It's a small addition that removes a repetitive step from your daily workflow, and it's ready for you to try right now on any paid plan.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
